passage.label: Servants who transgressed against themselves told not to despair of mercy, Allah forgives all sins, Forgiving Merciful; return in repentance and submit before punishment when none will help; follow the best revealed before sudden punishment; the soul's regret over neglect and mockery, the wish for guidance, the plea for another turn; the answer that the verses came but were denied in arrogance; blackened faces of the liars about Allah and Hell as residence for the arrogant; the God-fearing saved by their attainment untouched by evil or grief; Creator of all things and Disposer over all; keys of heavens and earth with the deniers as losers; the challenge to worship other than Allah; shirk rendering work worthless; worship Allah and be grateful; failure to appraise Him truly while the earth is in His grip and heavens folded in His right hand; the Horn blown with universal death save whom He wills then a second blast raising them; earth shining with its Lord's light, record placed, prophets and witnesses brought, judged in truth without wrong; every soul fully compensated; disbelievers driven in groups to Hell whose keepers ask about the messengers, the word of punishment taking effect; eternal entry and wretched residence of the arrogant; the God-fearing driven to Paradise greeted with peace and purity; praise for the fulfilled promise and inheritance of the earth to settle where they will; angels surrounding the Throne exalting with praise, judgement in truth, praise to the Lord of the worlds

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَأَنِيبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ وَأَسۡلِمُواْ لَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
وَٱتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَحۡسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةٗ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
أَن تَقُولَ نَفۡسٞ يَٰحَسۡرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّـٰخِرِينَ
أَوۡ تَقُولَ لَوۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
أَوۡ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةٗ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتِي فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسۡوَدَّةٌۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
وَيُنَجِّي ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ بِمَفَازَتِهِمۡ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٞ
لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
قُلۡ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأۡمُرُوٓنِّيٓ أَعۡبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ
وَلَقَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ لَئِنۡ أَشۡرَكۡتَ لَيَحۡبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعۡبُدۡ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ جَمِيعٗا قَبۡضَتُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطۡوِيَّـٰتُۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخۡرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ قِيَامٞ يَنظُرُونَ
وَأَشۡرَقَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَجِاْيٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ

وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّنكُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنۡ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ طِبۡتُمۡ فَٱدۡخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ
وَقَالُواْ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعۡدَهُۥ وَأَوۡرَثَنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ حَيۡثُ نَشَآءُۖ فَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
وَتَرَى ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنۡ حَوۡلِ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡۚ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَقِيلَ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

mainSubject.label: The address to self-transgressing servants forbidding despair because all sins are forgiven; repentance and submission urged before unhelped punishment, following the best revelation before it comes suddenly; the three regrets of neglect, absent guidance and the wish for a second turn answered by the arrival of denied verses; blackened faces and Hell for the arrogant liars against the God-fearing saved untouched by evil or grief; universal creation and disposal with the keys of the cosmos; the challenge over worship and the warning that shirk voids all work; the call to worship and gratitude; inadequate appraisal corrected by the earth in His grip and the heavens folded in His right hand; the double blast of the Horn with the willed exception; the illuminated earth, placed record, assembled prophets and witnesses, and truthful judgement without wrong; full compensation of every soul; the grouped drivings to Hell and Paradise with their keepers' words, the effective punishment decree, eternal entry, the greeting of peace and purity, the fulfilled promise and inherited settlement; the angels encircling the Throne in praise closing with hamd to the Lord of the worlds

subordinateSubjects.label: Self-transgressing servants told not to despair of mercy since Allah forgives all sins, being Forgiving and Merciful
Return in repentance and submission commanded before punishment arrives when no help remains
Following the best of what was revealed urged before punishment comes suddenly and unperceived
The soul's regret over neglect toward Allah and having been among the mockers
The soul's claim that had Allah guided it, it would have been among the righteous
The soul's wish for another turn to be among the doers of good upon seeing punishment
The rebuttal that His verses had come but were denied in arrogance and disbelief
Blackened faces of those who lied about Allah, with Hell as residence for the arrogant
The God-fearing saved by their attainment, untouched by evil and free of grief
Allah named Creator of all things and Disposer of affairs over all things
The keys of heavens and earth belonging to Him, with deniers of His verses named the losers
The challenge asking whether he is ordered to worship other than Allah, addressed to the ignorant
The revelation to him and to prior messengers that associating anything with Allah voids all work and brings loss
The command to worship Allah alone and be among the grateful
Failure to appraise Allah truly, corrected by the earth within His grip and the heavens folded in His right hand
The Horn blown causing universal death except whom He wills, then blown again raising them to look on
The earth shining with its Lord's light, the record placed, prophets and witnesses brought, and truthful judgement without wrong
Every soul fully compensated for what it did, with His knowledge of their deeds affirmed
Disbelievers driven in groups to Hell whose opened gates and keepers confront them with the messengers they denied, the punishment decree taking effect
The order to enter Hell's gates eternally, with the arrogant's residence named wretched
The God-fearing driven in groups to Paradise whose gates stand open and whose keepers greet them with peace and purity for eternal entry
Their praise for the fulfilled promise and inheritance of the earth to settle in Paradise wherever they will
Angels surrounding the Throne exalting with praise, judgement in truth, and praise declared to the Lord of the worlds

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: ۞قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah; indeed Allah forgives all sins.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَأَنِيبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ وَأَسۡلِمُواْ لَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Return in repentance to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَحۡسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةٗ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before punishment comes suddenly.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعۡبُدۡ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Rather, worship only Allah and be among the grateful.

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the patient-reward address (10) before the commissioned say-block opens (11); P2 ends at the expanded-breast/hardened-heart contrast (22); P3 runs from the best-statement description through the mutual-working challenge (23-40); P4 covers the Book-for-people declaration through the provision signs (41-52); P5 begins with the no-despair address and runs through judgement and the grouped drivings to the Throne close (53-75).
